sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:26:1
items.html: His HGT were included and clothed in his HBD, etc., and all the nine Sefirot of AA were included together: As above — for now he needs to receive from HGT of Atik, which stand in the place of the HGT of Nekudim; therefore AA must raise ZON, who stand in his NHY, up to his GAR, which clothe over the HGT of Atik. Therefore all the nine Sefirot of AA must be included one within the other, and these are the nine months; and then ZON reach the first Ibur of the internality, to receive from the HGT of Atik, as explained.
